text:
Ghair mutaliqa riwayat aur behas: Maqsad yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Quran-e-Kareem ko Lailatul Qadr mein nazil farmaya hai, isi ka naam Lailatul Mubarakah bhi hai aur jagah irshad hai "Inna Anzalnahu fi Lailatin Mubarakatin" aur yeh bhi Quran se sabit hai ke yeh raat Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke mahine mein hai jaise farmaya "Shahru Ramazanallazi Unzila fihil Quran". Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera ka qaul hai ke poora Quran-e-Pak Lauh-e-Mahfooz se aasman-e-awwal par Bait-ul-Izzat mein is raat utra, phir tafseel-war waqiyat ke mutabiq batadreej teees (23) saal mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil hua. Phir Allah Ta'ala Lailatul Qadr ki shaan-o-shaukat ka izhar farmata hai ke is raat ki ek zabardast barkat toh yeh hai ke Quran-e-Kareem jaisi aala nemat isi raat utri, toh farmata hai ke tumhein kya khabar Lailatul Qadr kya hai? Phir khud hi batata hai ke yeh ek raat ek hazar mahina se afzal hai. Imam Abu Isa Tirmidhi (R.H) Tirmidhi Sharif mein is ayat ki tafseer mein ek riwayat laye hain ke Yusuf bin Sa'ad ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A) se jabke aap ne Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) se sulah karli kaha ke tum ne iman walon ke munh kaale kar diye ya yun kaha ke ae momino! ke munh siyah karne wale, toh aap ne farmaya Allah tujh par raham kare mujh par khafa na ho, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dikhlaya gaya ke goya aap ke mimbar par Banu Umayyah hain, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh bura maloom hua toh "Inna A'tainakal Kausar" nazil hui, yani jannat ki nahar-e-Kausar aap ko ata kiye jaane ki khush khabri mili aur "Inna Anzalnahu" utri, pas hazar mahine se woh murad hain jin mein aap ke baad Banu Umayyah ki mamlikat rahegi. Qasim kehte hain hum ne hisab lagaya toh woh pooray ek hazar din hue na ek din zyada na ek din kam. Imam Tirmidhi is riwayat ko ghareeb batlate hain aur is ki sanad mein Yusuf bin Sa'ad hain jo majhool hain aur sirf isi ek sanad se yeh marwi hai. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Imam Tirmidhi ka yeh farmana ke yeh Yusuf majhool hain is mein zara tazabzub hai, is ke bohat se shagird hain, Yahya bin Mueen kehte hain yeh mashhoor hain aur siqah hain, aur is ki sanad mein kuch iztirab hai, jaisa bhi hai Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-surat yeh bohat hi munkar riwayat hai, hamare sheikh Hafiz Hujjat Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko munkar batlate hain. (Yeh yaad rahe ke Qasim ka qaul jo Tirmidhi ke hawalay se bayan hua hai) ke woh kehte hain hum ne hisab lagaya toh Banu Umayyah ki saltanat theek ek hazar din tak rahi, yeh nuskhe ki ghalti hai, ek hazar mahine likhna chahiye tha, main ne Tirmidhi Sharif mein dekha toh wahan bhi ek hazar mahine hain aur aagay bhi yahi aata hai.

Mutarjim Qasim bin Fazl Haddani ka yeh qaul ke Banu Umayya ki saltanat ki theek muddat ek hazar mahine thi yeh bhi sahih nahin is liye ke Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki mustaqil saltanat san 40 Hijri mein qaim hui jabke Hazrat Imam Hasan (R.A) ne aap ke hath par bai'at kar li aur amr-e-khilafat aap ko sonp diya aur sab log bhi Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki bai'at par jama ho gaye aur is saal ka naam hi Aam-ul-Jama'ah mashhoor hua. Phir Sham waghera mein barabar Banu Umayya ki saltanat qaim rahi. Haan taqreeban nau saal tak Haramain Sharifain aur Ahwaz aur ba'az shehron par Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) ki saltanat ho gayi thi lekin taham is muddat mein bhi kulliyat-an un ke hath se hukumat nahin gayi albata ba'az shehron par se hukumat hat gayi thi. Haan san 132 Hijri mein Banu Abbas ne un se khilafat apne qabze mein kar li, pas un ki saltanat ki muddat banwaye baras hui aur yeh ek hazar mah se bahut zyada hai. Ek hazar mahine ke tirasi saal char mah hote hain. Haan Qasim bin Fazl ka yeh hisab is tarah to taqreeban theek ho jata hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki muddat-e-khilafat is ginti mein se nikal di jaye, Wallahu A'lam.

Is riwayat ke za'eef hone ki ek yeh wajah bhi hai ke Banu Umayya ki saltanat ke zamane ki to burai aur mazammat bayan karni maqsood hai aur Lailat-ul-Qadr ki is zamane par fazeelat ka sabit hona kuch un ke zamane ki mazammat ki daleel nahin. Lailat-ul-Qadr to har tarah bandagi wali hai hi aur yeh poori surat is mubarak raat ki madd-o-sataish bayan kar rahi hai, pas Banu Umayya ke zamane ke dinon ki mazammat se Lailat-ul-Qadr ki kaunsi fazeelat sabit ho jayegi? Yeh to bilkul wahi misal ho jayegi ke koi shakhs talwar ki tareef karte hue kahe ke lakri se bahut tez hai. Kisi behtareen fazeelat wale shakhs ko kisi kam darja ke zaleel shakhs par fazeelat dena to us shareef buzurg ki tauheen karna hai. Aur wajah suniye, is riwayat ki bina par yeh ek hazar mahine woh hue jin mein Banu Umayya ki saltanat rahegi aur yeh surat utri hai Makka Sharif mein to is mein un mahinon ka hawala kaise diya ja sakta hai jo Banu Umayya ke zamane ke hain? Is par na to koi lafz dalalat karta hai na ma'ani ke taur par yeh samjha ja sakta hai. Mimbar to Madina mein qaim hota hai aur hijrat ki ek muddat baad mimbar banaya jata hai aur rakha jata hai. Pas in tamam wajooh se maloom hota hai ke yeh riwayat za'eef aur munkar hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Mah-e-Ramzan aur Lailatul Qadr ki fazeelat: Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bani Israel ke ek shakhs ka zikr kiya jo ek hazar mah tak Allah ki rah mein yani jihad mein hathiyar band raha. Musalmanon ko yeh sun kar ta'ajjub maloom hua toh Allah Azzawajal ne yeh Surah utari ke ek Lailatul Qadr ki ibadat us shakhs ki ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se afzal hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Bani Israel mein ek shakhs tha jo raat ko qayam karta tha subh tak aur din mein dushmanan-e-deen se jihad karta tha sham tak, ek hazar mahine tak yahi karta raha. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Surah nazil farmaya ke is ummat ke kisi shakhs ka sirf Lailatul Qadr ka qayam us aabid ki ek hazar mahine ki is ibadat se afzal hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bani Israel ke char aabidon ka zikr kiya jinhon ne assi saal tak Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki thi, ek aankh jhapne ke barabar bhi Allah ki nafarmani nahin ki thi. Hazrat Ayyub (A.S), Hazrat Zakariya (A.S), Hazrat Hizqeel bin Ajooz (A.S), Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S). Ashab-e-Rasool (R.A) ko sakht ta'ajjub hua. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki ummat ne is jamaat ki is ibadat par ta'ajjub kiya toh Allah Ta'ala ne is se bhi afzal cheez aap par nazil farmayi aur farmaya ke yeh afzal hai us se jin par aap aur aap ki ummat ne ta'ajjub zahir kiya tha. Pas An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke sahaba behad khush hue. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke is raat ka nek amal, is ka roza, is ki namaz ek hazar mahinon ke rozon aur namazon se afzal hai jin mein Lailatul Qadr na ho aur mufassireen ka bhi yeh qaul hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne bhi isi ko pasand farmaya hai ke woh ek hazar mahine jin mein Lailatul Qadr na ho, yahi theek hai. Is ke siwa aur koi qaul theek nahin, jaise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke ek raat ki jihad ki tayyari us ke siwa ki ek hazar raaton se afzal hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Isi tarah aur hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs achi niyat aur achi halat se Jumma ki namaz ke liye jaye us ke liye ek saal ke aamal ka sawab likha jata hai, saal bhar ke rozon ka aur saal bhar ki namazon ka, isi tarah ki aur bhi bahut si hadeesain hain. Pas matlab yeh hai ke murad ek hazar mahine se woh mahine hain jin mein Lailatul Qadr na aaye, jaise ek hazar raaton se murad woh raatein hain jin mein koi raat is ibadat ki na ho aur jaise Jumma ki taraf jane wale ko ek saal ki nekiyan yani woh saal jis mein Jumma na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke jab Ramzan aa gaya toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo! tum par Ramzan ka mahina aa gaya, yeh babarkat mahina aa gaya, is ke rozay Allah ne tum par farz kiye hain, is mein Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jate hain aur Jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jate hain, shayateen qaid kar liye jate hain, is mein ek raat hai jo ek hazar mahine se afzal hai, is ki bhalai se mehroom rehne wala haqeeqi badqismat hai. Nasai Shareef mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Chunke is raat ki ibadat ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se afzal hai is liye Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Jo shakhs Lailatul Qadr ka qayam imandari aur nek niyati se kare us ke tamam sabqa gunah bakhash diye jate hain. Phir farmata hai ke is raat ki barkat ki ziyadti ki wajah se bakasrat farishtay is mein nazil hote hain. Farishtay toh har barkat aur rahmat ke sath nazil hote rehte hain jaise tilawat-e-Quran ke waqt utarte hain aur zikr ki majlison ko gher lete hain aur ilm-e-deen ke seekhne walon ke liye raazi khushi apne par bicha diya karte hain aur is ki izzat-o-takreem karte hain. Rooh se murad yahan Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) hain, yeh khas ka atf hai aam par. Baaz kehte hain Rooh naam ke ek khas qisam ke farishtay hain jaise ke Surah Amma Yatasa'aloon ki tafseer mein tafseel se guzar chuka, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya woh sarasar salamti wali raat hai jis mein shaitan na toh burai kar sakta hai na eiza pahuncha sakta hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) wagairah farmate hain is mein tamam kamon ka faisla kiya jata hai, umr aur rizq muqaddar kiya jata hai jaise aur jagah hai: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem, yani isi raat mein har hikmat wale kaam ka faisla kiya jata hai. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) farmate hain ke is raat mein farishtay masjid walon par subh tak salam bhejte rehte hain. Imam Baihaqi (R.H) ne apni kitab Faza'il-e-Auqat mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka ek ghareeb asar farishton ke nazil hone mein aur namaziyon par un ke guzarne mein aur unhein barkat hasil hone mein warid kiya hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) se ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb bahut tool-taweel asar warid kiya hai jis mein farishton ka Sidratul Muntaha se Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath zameen par aana aur momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye duayein karna warid hai. Abu Dawood Tayalisi (R.H) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Lailatul Qadr sattaisween hai ya untisween, is raat mein farishtay zameen par sangrezon ki ginti se bhi zyada hote hain.

Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Ya'la farmate hain is raat mein har amr-e-ilahi se salamti hai yani koi nayi baat paida nahin hoti. Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid ka qaul hai ke yeh raat sarasar salamti wali hai, koi burai subah hone tak nahin hoti. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Lailatul-Qadr aakhri das raaton mein hai, jo in mein talab-e-sawab ki niyat se qayam kare Allah Ta'ala uske agle aur pichle gunah maaf farma deta hai. Yeh raat akai ki hai yani ikkiswein ya teisswein ya pachiswein ya sataiswein ya aakhri raat. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain yeh raat bilkul saaf aur aisi roshan hoti hai ke goya chand chadha hua hai, is mein sukoon aur diljam'i hoti hai, na sardi zyada hoti hai na garmi, subah tak sitare nahin jhadte. Ek nishani iski yeh bhi hai ke is subah ko suraj tez shuaon ke sath nahin nikalta balkeh woh chaudahwein raat ki tarah saaf nikalta hai. Is din uske sath shaitan bhi nahin nikalta. Yeh asnad to sahih hai lekin matan mein gharabat hai aur ba'az alfaaz mein nakarat bhi hai. Aur Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Lailatul-Qadr saaf pur-sukoon sardi garmi se khali raat hai, iski subah madham roshni wala surkh rang nikalta hai. Hazrat Abu Asim Nabeel apni asnad se Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne ek martaba farmaya main Lailatul-Qadr dikhlaya gaya phir bhula diya gaya, yeh aakhri das raaton mein hai, yeh saaf shaffaf sukoon-o-waqar wali raat hai, na zyada sardi hoti hai na zyada garmi, is qadar roshni raat hoti hai ke yeh maloom hota hai goya chand chadha hua hai, suraj ke sath shaitan nahin nikalta yahan tak ke dhoop chadh jaye.

Fasl: Is baab mein ulama ka ikhtilaf hai ke Lailatul-Qadr agli ummaton mein bhi thi ya sirf isi ummat ko khusoosiyat ke sath ata ki gayi hai. Pas ek hadith mein to yeh aaya hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne jab nazrein dalein aur yeh maloom kiya ke sabqa logon ki umrein bahut zyada hoti thin to aap (ﷺ) ko khayal guzra ke meri ummat ki umrein unke muqable mein kam hain to nekiyan bhi kam rahengi aur phir darajat aur sawab mein bhi kami rahengi to Allah Ta'ala ne aap (ﷺ) ko yeh raat inayat farmayi aur iska sawab ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se zyada dene ka wada farmaya. Is hadith se to yeh maloom hota hai ke sirf isi ummat ko yeh raat di gayi hai, balkeh sahib-e-Uddah ne jo Shafiya mein se ek imam hain, jamhoor-e-ulama ka yahi qaul naqal kiya hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur Khattabi ne to is par ijma naqal kiya hai lekin ek aur hadith hai jis se yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh raat jis tarah is ummat mein hai, agli ummaton mein bhi thi. Chunancha Hazrat Marsad farmate hain main ne Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se poocha ke aap ne Lailatul-Qadr ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kya sawal kiya tha? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya suno main Huzoor (ﷺ) se aksar baatein daryaft karta rehta tha, ek martaba main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to farmaiye ke Lailatul-Qadr Ramzan mein hi hai ya aur mahinon mein? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ramzan mein.

Main ne kaha achha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh ambiya ke sath hi hai ke jab tak woh hain yeh bhi hai jab ambiya qabz kiye jate hain to yeh uth jati hain ya yeh Qayamat tak baqi rahengi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke nahin woh Qayamat tak baqi rahegi, main ne kaha achha Ramzan ke kis hissa mein hai? Aap ne farmaya ise Ramzan ke pehle aur aakhri ashra mein dhoond. Phir main khamosh ho gaya, aap bhi aur baton mein mashghool ho gaye. Main ne phir mauqa pa kar sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in dono asharon mein se kis ashre mein is raat ko talash karoon? Aap ne farmaya aakhri ashre mein, bas kuch na poochna main phir chupka ho gaya lekin phir mauqa pa kar main ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki qasam hai mera bhi kuch haq aap par hai farma dijiye ke woh kaunsi raat hai? Aap sakht gusse hue main ne to kabhi aap ko apne oopar itna gussa hue hue dekha hi nahin aur farmaya aakhri hafta mein talash karo, ab kuch na poocha. Yeh riwayat Nasai mein bhi marwi hai is se sabit hota hai ke yeh raat agli ummaton mein bhi thi, aur is hadith se bhi yeh sabit hota hai ke yeh raat Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad bhi Qayamat tak har saal aati rahegi. Baaz Shia ka qaul hai ke yeh raat bilkul uth gayi, yeh qaul ghalat hai un ko ghalat fehmi is hadith se hui hai jis mein hai ke woh utha li gayi aur mumkin hai ke tumhare liye isi mein behtari ho yeh hadith poori bhi aayegi. Matlab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman se yeh hai ke is raat ki ta'ayyun aur is ka taqarrur bhi sath gaya na yeh ke sire se Lailatul Qadr hi uth gayi mandaraja bala hadith se yeh bhi maloom hua ke yeh raat Ramzan Sharif mein aati hai kisi aur mahina mein nahin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur ulama-e-Kufa ka qaul hai ke sare saal mein ek raat hai aur har mahina mein is ka ho jana mumkin hai. Yeh hadith is ke khilaf hai Sunan Abu Dawood mein baab hai ke us shakhs ki daleel jo kehta hai Lailatul Qadr sare Ramzan mein hai. Phir hadith laye ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Lailatul Qadr ke bare mein poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya ke sare Ramzan mein hai, is ki sanad ke kul rawi siqa hain yeh mauqoof bhi marwi hain Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) se ek riwayat mein hai ke Ramzan-ul-Mubarak ke sare mahina mein is raat ka hona mumkin hai Ghazali ne isi ko naqal kiya hai lekin Rafai ise bilkul ghareeb batlate hain.

Fasl: Abu Zareen R.H farmate hain ke Ramzan ki pehli raat hi Lailatul Qadr hai. Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H ka irfan hai ke yeh satraween shab hai. Abu Dawood mein is mazmoon ki ek hadith marfoo marwi hai aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A aur Hazrat Usman bin Al-Aas R.A se mauqoof bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri R.H ka mazhab bhi yahi naqal kiya gaya hai. Is ki ek daleel yeh bhi bayan ki jaati hai ke Ramzan-ul-Mubarak ki yahi satraween raat shab-e-jumma thi aur yahi raat Badr ki raat thi aur satraween tareekh ko jang-e-Badr waqay hui thi jis din ko Quran ne Yaum-ul-Furqan kaha hai. Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se marwi hai ke unneesween raat Lailatul Qadr hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ikeesween raat hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ramzan Shareef ke das pehle din ka aitikaf kiya, hum bhi aap ke saath hi aitikaf baithe. Phir aap ke paas Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye aur farmaya ke jise aap dhoondte hain woh toh aap ke aage hai. Phir aap ne das se bees tak ka aitikaf kiya aur hum ne bhi. Phir Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye aur yahi farmaya ke jise aap dhoondte hain woh toh abhi bhi aage hain yani Lailatul Qadr. Pas Ramzan ki beesween tareekh ki subah ko Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khade ho kar khutba farmaya aur farmaya ke mere saath aitikaf karne walon ko chahiye ke woh phir aitikaf mein baith jayen, main ne Lailatul Qadr dekh li lekin main bhool gaya. Lailatul Qadr aakhri ashre ki taaq raaton mein hai, main ne dekha hai ke goya main keechad mein sajda kar raha hoon. Rawi-e-hadith farmate hain ke Masjid-e-Nabwi ki chhat sirf khajoor ke patton ki thi, aasman par us waqt abr ka ek chhota sa tukda bhi na tha, phir abr utha aur barish hui aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khwab saccha hua aur main ne khud dekha ke namaz ke baad aap ki peshani par tar mitti lagi hui thi. Isi riwayat ke ek tareeq mein hai ke yeh ikeesween raat ka waqia hai. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim dono mein hai. Imam Shafi'i R.H farmate hain tamam riwayaton mein se zyada sahih yahi hadith hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Lailatul Qadr Ramzan Shareef ki taisseween raat hai aur is ki daleel Hazrat Abdullah bin Anees R.A ki Sahih Muslim wali aisi hi ek riwayat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh chaubeesween raat hai. Abu Dawood Tayalisi R.H mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Lailatul Qadr chaubeesween shab hai, is ki sanad bhi sahih hai. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein bhi yeh riwayat hai lekin is ki sanad mein Ibn-e-Lahi'ah hain jo za'eef hain. Bukhari mein Hazrat Bilal R.A se jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke moazzin hain, marwi hai ke yeh pehli saatween hai aakhri das mein se, yeh mauqoof riwayat hi sahih hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood, Ibn-e-Abbas, Jabir, Hasan, Qatadah, Abdullah bin Wahb bhi farmate hain ke chaubeesween raat Lailatul Qadr hai. Surah Baqarah ki tafsir mein Hazrat Wasilah bin Asqa ki riwayat ki hui marfoo hadith bayan ho chuki hai ke Quran-e-Karim Ramzan Sharif ki chaubeesween raat ko utra. Ba'az kehte hain pacheesween raat Lailatul Qadr hai, unki daleel Bukhari Sharif ki yeh hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ise Ramzan ke aakhri ashre mein dhoondo. Nau baqi rahein tab, saat baqi rahein tab, paanch baqi rahein tab. Aksar muhaddiseen ne iska yahi matlab bayan kiya hai ke is se murad taaq raatein hain, yahi zyada zahir hai aur zyada mashhoor hai, go ba'az auron ne ise juft raaton par bhi mahmool kiya hai jaise ke Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Saeed ne ise juft par mahmool kiya hai, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh sataisween raat hai, iski daleel Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai jis mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain yeh sataisween raat hai. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai, Hazrat Zirr ne Hazrat Ubayy ibn-e-Ka'ab (R.A) se kaha ke aap ke bhai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) toh farmate hain jo shakhs saal bhar raaton ko qayam karega woh Lailatul Qadr ko payega. Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala un par raham kare, woh jaante hain ke yeh raat Ramzan mein hi hai, yeh sataisween raat Ramzan ki hai. Phir is baat par Hazrat Ubayy ne qasam khai, maine poocha aap ko yeh kaise maloom hua? Jawab diya ke un nishaniyon ko dekhne se jo humein batayi gayi hain ke us din sooraj shua'on baghair nikalta hai.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ubayy R.A ne kaha us Allah ki qasam jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin ke yeh raat Ramzan mein hi hai, aap ne is par Insha'Allah bhi nahin farmaya aur pukhta qasam kha li. Phir farmaya mujhe khoob maloom hai ke woh kaunsi raat hai jis mein qayam karne ka Rasool Allah ﷺ ka hukum hai, yeh sataiswein (27th) raat hai. Is ki nishani yeh hai ke is ki subh ko suraj safed rang nikalta hai aur tezi zyada nahin hoti. Hazrat Muawiyah, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera se bhi marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya yeh raat sataiswein raat hai, salaf ki ek jamaat ne bhi yahi kaha hai aur Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H ka mukhtar maslak bhi yahi hai aur Imam Abu Hanifa R.H se ek riwayat isi qaul ki manqool hai. Baaz salaf ne Quran-e-Kareem ke alfaaz se bhi is ke suboot ka hawala diya hai is tarah ke "Hiya" is surat mein sataiswan (27th) kalma hai aur is ke ma'ani hain "yeh", Fallahu A'lam. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne as-hab-e-Rasool ﷺ ko jama kiya aur un se Lailatul Qadr ki babat sawal kiya to sab ka ijma is amr par hua ke yeh Ramzan ke aakhri ashra mein hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ne us waqt farmaya ke main to yeh bhi jaanta hoon ke woh kaunsi raat hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya phir kaho woh kaunsi raat hai? Farmaya is aakhri ashray mein saat (7) guzarne par ya saat baqi rehne par. Hazrat Umar R.A ne poocha yeh kaise maloom hua to jawab diya ke dekho Allah Ta'ala ne aasman bhi saat paida kiye aur zameen bhi saat banayin, mahina bhi hafton par hai, insaan ki paidaish bhi saat par hai, khana bhi saat hai, sajda bhi saat par hai, tawaf-e-Baitullah ki tadaad bhi saat ki hai, rami-e-jamar ki kankariyan bhi saat hain aur isi tarah ki saat ki ginti ki bohat si cheezein aur ginwa dein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne farmaya tumhari samajh wahan pahunchi jahan tak hamare khayalat ko rasai na ho saki. Yeh jo farmaya saat hi khana hai is se Quran-e-Kareem ki aayatein (Fa-anbatna feeha habba) (80. Abasa: 27) murad hain jin mein saat cheezon ka zikr hai jo khai jaati hain. Is ki asnaad bhi jayyid aur qawi hai ke untiswein (29th) raat hai. Hazrat Ubadah bin Samit R.A ke sawal ke jawab mein Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha ke ise aakhri ashray mein dhoondo taaq raaton mein, ikees (21), teees (23), pachees (25), satais (27) aur untis (29) ya aakhri raat. Musnad mein hai ke Lailatul Qadr sataiswein raat hai, ya untiswein. Is raat farishtay zameen par sangrezon ki ginti se bhi zyada hote hain, is ki asnaad bhi achi hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke aakhri raat Lailatul Qadr hai kyunke abhi jo hadith guzri is mein hai aur Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi hai ke jab nau (9) baqi reh jayen ya saat (7) ya paanch (5) ya teen (3) ya aakhri raat yani in raaton mein Lailatul Qadr ki talash karo, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, Musnad mein hai yeh aakhri raat hai.

Fasl: Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain ke in mukhtalif ahadith mein tatbiq yun ho sakti hai ke yeh sawalon ka jawab hai. Kisi ne kaha Hazrat hum ise falan raat mein talash karein? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya haan. Haqiqat yeh hai ke Lailatul Qadr muqarrar hai aur is mein tabdili nahin hoti. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka isi ma'ani ka qaul naqal kiya hai. Abu Qilabah (R.H) farmate hain ke aakhri ashre ki raaton mein yeh pher badal hua karti hai. Imam Malik (R.H), Imam Thawri (R.H), Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H), Imam Ishaq bin Rahuyah (R.H), Abu Thawr Muzni (R.H), Abu Bakr bin Khuzaymah (R.H) waghera ne bhi yahi farmaya hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) se bhi Qazi ne yahi naqal kiya hai aur yahi theek bhi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Is qaul ki thodi bahut ta'eed Bukhari-o-Muslim ki is hadith se bhi hoti hai ke chand ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khwab mein Lailatul Qadr Ramzan ki saat pichli raaton mein dikhaye gaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Main dekhta hoon ke tumhare khwab is bare mein muwafiq hain, har talab karne wale ko chahiye ke Lailatul Qadr ko in saat aakhri raaton mein talash kare. Hazrat Ayesha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se bhi Bukhari-o-Muslim mein marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Ramzan ke aakhri ashre ki taaq raaton mein Shab-e-Qadr ki justuju karo.

Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ke is farman par ke Lailatul Qadr har Ramzan mein ek mu'ayyan raat hai aur is ka her pher nahin hota, yeh hadith daleel ban sakti hai jo Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki riwayat se marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein Lailatul Qadr ki khabar dene ke liye (ke falan raat Lailatul Qadr hai) nikle. Do musalman aapas mein jhagad rahe thay to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke main tumhein Lailatul Qadr ki khabar dene ke liye aaya tha lekin falan falan ki ladai ki wajah se woh utha li gayi aur mumkin hai ke isi mein tumhari behtari ho, ab ise nawin, saatwin aur panchwin mein dhoondo.

Wajah-e-dalalat yeh hai ke agar is ka ta'ayyun hamesha ke liye na hota to har saal ki Lailatul Qadr ka ilm hasil na hota. Agar Lailatul Qadr ka taghayyur-o-tabaddul hota rehta to sirf us saal ke liye to maloom ho jata ke falan raat hai lekin aur barson ke liye ta'ayyun na hoti. Haan yeh ek jawab is ka ho sakta hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf usi saal ki is mubarak raat ki khabar dene ke liye tashreef laye thay. Is hadith se yeh bhi maloom hua ke ladai jhagda khair-o-barkat aur nafa dene wale ilm ko gharat kar deta hai. Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai ke banda apne gunah ke ba'is Allah ki rozi se mehroom rakh diya jata hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke is hadith mein jo Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke woh utha li gayi, is se murad is ke ta'ayyun ke ilm ka utha liya jana hai, na yeh ke bilkul Lailatul Qadr hi duniya se utha li gayi, jaise ke jahil Shia ka qaul hai. Is par badi daleel yeh hai ke is lafz ke baad hi yeh hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ise nawin, saatwin aur panchwin mein dhoondo.

Aap ka yeh farman ke mumkin hai isi mein tumhari behtari ho yani is ki muqarrara ta'ayyun ka ilm na hone mein, is ka matlab yeh hai ke jab yeh mubham hai to is ka dhoondne wala jin jin raaton mein is ka hona mumkin dekhe ga un tamam raaton mein koshish-o-khuloos ke sath ibadat mein laga rahe ga, bakhilaf is ke ke maloom ho jaye ke falan raat hi hai to woh sirf isi ek raat ki ibadat kare ga kyunke himmatein past hain, is liye hikmat-e-hakeem ka taqaza yahi hua ke is raat ke ta'ayyun ki khabar na di jaye taake is raat ke pa lene ke shauq mein is mubarak mahina mein jee laga kar aur dil khol kar bande apne Ma'bood-e-Barhaq ki bandagi karein aur aakhri ashre mein to poori koshish aur khuloos ke sath ibadaton mein mashghool rahein. Isi liye khud Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi apne inteqal tak Ramzan Sharif ke aakhri ashre ka aitikaf karte rahe aur aap ke baad aap ki azwaj-e-mutahharat ne aitikaf kiya, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki riwayat mein hai ke aap Ramzan Sharif ke aakhri ashre ka aitikaf kiya karte the. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ke jab aakhri das raatein Ramzan Sharif ki reh jatin to Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sari raat jaagte, apne ghar walon ko bhi jagate aur kamar kas lete (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in dinon mein jis mehnat ke sath ibadat karte utni mehnat se ibadat aap ki aur dinon mein nahin hoti thi. Yahi ma'ani hain oopar wali hadith ke is jumla ke ke aap tehband mazboot bandh liya karte yani kamar kas liya karte yani ibadat mein poori koshish karte, go is ke yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke aap biwiyon se na milte aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke dono hi baatein murad hon yani biwiyon se milna bhi tark kar dete the aur ibadat ki mashghooli mein bhi kamar bandh liya karte the. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith ke yeh alfaaz hain ke jab Ramzan ka aakhri ashra baqi reh jata to aap tehband mazboot bandh lete aur aurton se alag rehte. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain ke Ramzan ki aakhri das raaton mein Lailatul Qadr ki yaksan justuju kare, kisi ek raat ko dusri raat par tarjeeh na de (Sharh-e-Rafe'i). Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke yun to har waqt dua ki kasrat mustahab hai lekin Ramzan mein aur ziyadati kare aur khusoosan aakhri ashre mein aur bilkhusoos taaq raaton mein is dua ko ba-kasrat padhe: "Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni" (Aye Allah! Tu darguzar karne wala hai aur darguzar ko pasand farmane wala hai, mujh se bhi darguzar farma).

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke agar mujhe Lailatul Qadr mil jaye to main kya dua parhoon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yehi dua batayi. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh marwi hai aur Imam Hakim (R.H) ise shart-e-Bukhari-o-Muslim par sahih batate hain.

Ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar jis ka talluq Lailatul Qadr se hai, Imam Abu Muhammad bin Abu Hatim (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein is Surah ki tafsir mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) se is riwayat ke sath warid kiya hai ke Sidratul Muntaha jo saatwein aasman ki had par jannat se mutasil hai, jo duniya aur aakhirat ke fasle par hai, us ki bulandi jannat mein hai. Us ki shakhein aur daalein Kursi tale hain. Us mein is qadar farishtay hain jin ki ginti Allah Ta'ala ke siwa aur koi nahin jaanta. Us ki har ek shaakh par beshumar farishtay hain, ek baal barabar bhi jagah aisi nahin jo farishton se khaali ho. Us darakht ke beechon-beech Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ka maqam hai. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko aawaz di jaati hai ke, "Ae Jibraeel! Lailatul Qadr mein is darakht ke tamam farishton ko le kar zameen par jao." Yeh kul ke kul farishtay raafat-o-rahmat wale hain, jin ke dilon mein har har momin ke liye raham ke jazbaat maujzan hain.

Suraj ghuroob hote hi yeh kul ke kul farishtay Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath Lailatul Qadr mein utarte hain, tamam roo-e-zameen par phail jaate hain, har har jagah par sajde mein, qayam mein mashghool ho jaate hain aur tamam momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye duayein maangte rehte hain. Haan, girja ghar mein, mandir mein, aatish kaday mein, but khanay mein, gharz Allah ke siwa auron ki jahan parastish hoti hai wahan to yeh farishtay nahin jaate. Aur un jaghon mein bhi jin mein tum gandi cheezein daalte ho aur us ghar mein bhi jahan nashe wala shakhs ho ya nasha wali cheez ho ya jis ghar mein koi but gara hua ho ya jis ghar mein baajay gaajay ghantiyan hon ya mujasma ho ya koora karkat daalne ki jagah ho, wahan to yeh rahmat ke farishtay jaate nahin. Baqi chappe chappe par ghoom jaate hain aur saari raat momin mardon aurton ke liye duayein maangne mein guzaarte hain.

Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) tamam mominon se musafa karte hain. Us ki nishani yeh hai ke roo'ein jism par kharay ho jayen, dil narm par jaye, aankhein beh niklein. Us waqt aadmi ko samajh lena chahiye ke is waqt mera haath Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke haath mein hai. Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain, jo shakhs is raat mein teen martaba 'La ilaha illallah' parhay, us ki pehli martaba ke parhne par gunahon ki bakhshish ho jaati hai, dusri martaba ke kehne par aag se nijaat mil jaati hai, teesri martaba ke kehne par jannat mein dakhil ho jaata hai. Rawi ne poocha ke ae Abu Ishaq! Jo is kalma ko sachayi se kahe us ke? Farmaya: Yeh to nikle ga hi us ke munh se jo sachayi se is ka kehne wala ho. Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke Lailatul Qadr kafir-o-munafiq par to itni bhaari parti hai ke goya us ki peeth par pahar aa para.

Garaz fajr hone tak farishtay isi tarah rehte hain phir sab se pehle Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) charhte hain aur bohat oonchay charh kar apne paron ko phaila dete hain bilkhusoos un do sabz paron ko jinhein is raat ke siwa woh kabhi nahin phailatay, yahi wajah hai ke suraj ki tezi maand par jati hai aur shua'ein jati rehti hain, phir ek ek farishtay ko pukarte hain aur sab ke sab oopar charhte hain, pas farishton ka noor aur Jibraeel (A.S) ke paron ka noor mil kar suraj ko maand kar deta hai, is din suraj mutahayyar reh jata hai, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aur yeh saaray ke saaray beshumar farishtay is din aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye rahmat ki duayein mangte hain aur un ke gunahon ki bakhshish talab karne mein guzar dete hain, nek niyati ke sath rozay rakhne walon ke liye aur un logon ke liye bhi jin ka yeh khayal raha ke aglay saal bhi agar Allah ne zindagi rakhi to Ramzan ke rozay umdagi ke sath pooray karenge, yahi duayein mangte rehte hain, shaam ko dunya ke aasman par charh jate hain, wahan ke tamam farishtay halqay baandh baandh kar un ke paas jama ho jate hain aur ek ek mard aur ek ek aurat ke baray mein un se sawal karte hain aur yeh jawab dete hain, yahan tak ke woh poochte hain ke falan shakhs ko imsaal tum ne kis halat mein paya? To yeh kehte hain ke guzishta saal to hum ne usay ibadaton mein paya tha lekin is saal to woh bid'aton mein mubtala tha aur falan shakhs guzishta saal bid'aton mein mubtala tha lekin is saal hum ne usay sunnat ke mutabiq ibadaton mein paya, pas yeh farishtay us pehle shakhs ke liye bakhshish ki duayein mangni mauqoof kar dete hain aur is dusray shakhs ke liye shuru kar dete hain aur yeh farishtay unhein sunate hain ke falan falan ko hum ne zikr-e-Allah mein paya aur falan ko ruku mein aur falan ko sajday mein aur falan ko Kitabullah ki tilawat mein, garaz ek raat din yahan guzar kar dusray aasman par jate hain, yahan bhi yahi hota hai yahan tak ke Sidratul Muntaha mein apni apni jagah pahunch jate hain, us waqt Sidratul Muntaha un se poochta hai ke mujh mein basne walo! Mera bhi tum par haq hai, mein bhi un se mohabbat rakhta hoon jo Allah se mohabbat rakhein, zara mujhe bhi to logon ki halat ki khabar do aur un ke naam batao, Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) farmate hain ke ab farishtay us ke samne ginti kar ke aur ek ek mard-o-aurat ka ma'a walidiyat ke naam batate hain, phir Jannat Sidratul Muntaha ki taraf mutawajja ho kar poochti hai ke tujh mein rehne wale farishton ne jo khabrein tujhe di hain mujh se bhi to bayan kar, chunancha Sidra us se zikr karta hai, yeh sun kar woh kehti hai Allah ki rahmat ho falan mard aur falan aurat par, Allah unhein jaldi mujh se mila, Jibraeel (A.S) sab se pehle apni jagah pahunch jate hain, unhein ilham hota hai aur yeh arz karte hain: Parwardigar! Mein ne tere falan falan bandon ko sajday mein paya to unhein bakhsh, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mein ne unhein bakhsha, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) usay Arsh ke uthane wale farishton ko sunate hain, phir sab kehte hain falan falan mard-o-aurat par Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat hui aur maghfirat hui, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) khabar dete hain ke Bari Ta'ala! Falan shakhs ko guzishta saal to aamil-e-sunnat aur aabid chora tha lekin imsaal to bid'aton mein par gaya aur tere ahkaam se rogardani kar li hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Ae Jibraeel! Agar yeh marne se teen sa'at pehle bhi tauba kar le ga to mein usay bakhsh doonga, us waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) besakhta keh uthte hain: Allah! Tere hi liye sab tareefein sazawaar hain, Ilahi! Tu apni makhlooq par sab se zyada meharban hai, bandon par teri meharbani khud un ki meharbani se bhi barhi hui hai, us waqt Arsh aur us ke aas paas ki cheezein, parday aur tamam aasman junbish mein aa jate hain aur keh uthte hain: Alhamdulillahir-Raheem.

Alhamdulillahir-Rahim, Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) yeh bhi farmate hain ke jo shakhs Ramazan Sharif ke rozay pooray kare aur uski niyat yeh ho ke Ramazan ke baad bhi main gunahon se bachta rahoonga woh baghair sawal jawab ke aur baghair hisab-o-kitab ke Jannat mein dakhil hoga, Surah Lailatul Qadr ki tafsir Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Ghair mutaliqa riwayat aur behas: Maqsad yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Quran-e-Kareem ko Lailatul Qadr mein nazil farmaya hai, isi ka naam Lailatul Mubarakah bhi hai aur jagah irshad hai "Inna Anzalnahu fi Lailatin Mubarakatin" aur yeh bhi Quran se sabit hai ke yeh raat Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke mahine mein hai jaise farmaya "Shahru Ramazanallazi Unzila fihil Quran". Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera ka qaul hai ke poora Quran-e-Pak Lauh-e-Mahfooz se aasman-e-awwal par Bait-ul-Izzat mein is raat utra, phir tafseel-war waqiyat ke mutabiq batadreej teees (23) saal mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil hua. Phir Allah Ta'ala Lailatul Qadr ki shaan-o-shaukat ka izhar farmata hai ke is raat ki ek zabardast barkat toh yeh hai ke Quran-e-Kareem jaisi aala nemat isi raat utri, toh farmata hai ke tumhein kya khabar Lailatul Qadr kya hai? Phir khud hi batata hai ke yeh ek raat ek hazar mahina se afzal hai. Imam Abu Isa Tirmidhi (R.H) Tirmidhi Sharif mein is ayat ki tafseer mein ek riwayat laye hain ke Yusuf bin Sa'ad ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A) se jabke aap ne Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) se sulah karli kaha ke tum ne iman walon ke munh kaale kar diye ya yun kaha ke ae momino! ke munh siyah karne wale, toh aap ne farmaya Allah tujh par raham kare mujh par khafa na ho, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dikhlaya gaya ke goya aap ke mimbar par Banu Umayyah hain, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh bura maloom hua toh "Inna A'tainakal Kausar" nazil hui, yani jannat ki nahar-e-Kausar aap ko ata kiye jaane ki khush khabri mili aur "Inna Anzalnahu" utri, pas hazar mahine se woh murad hain jin mein aap ke baad Banu Umayyah ki mamlikat rahegi. Qasim kehte hain hum ne hisab lagaya toh woh pooray ek hazar din hue na ek din zyada na ek din kam. Imam Tirmidhi is riwayat ko ghareeb batlate hain aur is ki sanad mein Yusuf bin Sa'ad hain jo majhool hain aur sirf isi ek sanad se yeh marwi hai. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Imam Tirmidhi ka yeh farmana ke yeh Yusuf majhool hain is mein zara tazabzub hai, is ke bohat se shagird hain, Yahya bin Mueen kehte hain yeh mashhoor hain aur siqah hain, aur is ki sanad mein kuch iztirab hai, jaisa bhi hai Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-surat yeh bohat hi munkar riwayat hai, hamare sheikh Hafiz Hujjat Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko munkar batlate hain. (Yeh yaad rahe ke Qasim ka qaul jo Tirmidhi ke hawalay se bayan hua hai) ke woh kehte hain hum ne hisab lagaya toh Banu Umayyah ki saltanat theek ek hazar din tak rahi, yeh nuskhe ki ghalti hai, ek hazar mahine likhna chahiye tha, main ne Tirmidhi Sharif mein dekha toh wahan bhi ek hazar mahine hain aur aagay bhi yahi aata hai.

Mutarjim Qasim bin Fazl Haddani ka yeh qaul ke Banu Umayya ki saltanat ki theek muddat ek hazar mahine thi yeh bhi sahih nahin is liye ke Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki mustaqil saltanat san 40 Hijri mein qaim hui jabke Hazrat Imam Hasan (R.A) ne aap ke hath par bai'at kar li aur amr-e-khilafat aap ko sonp diya aur sab log bhi Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki bai'at par jama ho gaye aur is saal ka naam hi Aam-ul-Jama'ah mashhoor hua. Phir Sham waghera mein barabar Banu Umayya ki saltanat qaim rahi. Haan taqreeban nau saal tak Haramain Sharifain aur Ahwaz aur ba'az shehron par Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) ki saltanat ho gayi thi lekin taham is muddat mein bhi kulliyat-an un ke hath se hukumat nahin gayi albata ba'az shehron par se hukumat hat gayi thi. Haan san 132 Hijri mein Banu Abbas ne un se khilafat apne qabze mein kar li, pas un ki saltanat ki muddat banwaye baras hui aur yeh ek hazar mah se bahut zyada hai. Ek hazar mahine ke tirasi saal char mah hote hain. Haan Qasim bin Fazl ka yeh hisab is tarah to taqreeban theek ho jata hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki muddat-e-khilafat is ginti mein se nikal di jaye, Wallahu A'lam.

Is riwayat ke za'eef hone ki ek yeh wajah bhi hai ke Banu Umayya ki saltanat ke zamane ki to burai aur mazammat bayan karni maqsood hai aur Lailat-ul-Qadr ki is zamane par fazeelat ka sabit hona kuch un ke zamane ki mazammat ki daleel nahin. Lailat-ul-Qadr to har tarah bandagi wali hai hi aur yeh poori surat is mubarak raat ki madd-o-sataish bayan kar rahi hai, pas Banu Umayya ke zamane ke dinon ki mazammat se Lailat-ul-Qadr ki kaunsi fazeelat sabit ho jayegi? Yeh to bilkul wahi misal ho jayegi ke koi shakhs talwar ki tareef karte hue kahe ke lakri se bahut tez hai. Kisi behtareen fazeelat wale shakhs ko kisi kam darja ke zaleel shakhs par fazeelat dena to us shareef buzurg ki tauheen karna hai. Aur wajah suniye, is riwayat ki bina par yeh ek hazar mahine woh hue jin mein Banu Umayya ki saltanat rahegi aur yeh surat utri hai Makka Sharif mein to is mein un mahinon ka hawala kaise diya ja sakta hai jo Banu Umayya ke zamane ke hain? Is par na to koi lafz dalalat karta hai na ma'ani ke taur par yeh samjha ja sakta hai. Mimbar to Madina mein qaim hota hai aur hijrat ki ek muddat baad mimbar banaya jata hai aur rakha jata hai. Pas in tamam wajooh se maloom hota hai ke yeh riwayat za'eef aur munkar hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Mah-e-Ramzan aur Lailatul Qadr ki fazeelat: Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bani Israel ke ek shakhs ka zikr kiya jo ek hazar mah tak Allah ki rah mein yani jihad mein hathiyar band raha. Musalmanon ko yeh sun kar ta'ajjub maloom hua toh Allah Azzawajal ne yeh Surah utari ke ek Lailatul Qadr ki ibadat us shakhs ki ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se afzal hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Bani Israel mein ek shakhs tha jo raat ko qayam karta tha subh tak aur din mein dushmanan-e-deen se jihad karta tha sham tak, ek hazar mahine tak yahi karta raha. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Surah nazil farmaya ke is ummat ke kisi shakhs ka sirf Lailatul Qadr ka qayam us aabid ki ek hazar mahine ki is ibadat se afzal hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bani Israel ke char aabidon ka zikr kiya jinhon ne assi saal tak Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki thi, ek aankh jhapne ke barabar bhi Allah ki nafarmani nahin ki thi. Hazrat Ayyub (A.S), Hazrat Zakariya (A.S), Hazrat Hizqeel bin Ajooz (A.S), Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S). Ashab-e-Rasool (R.A) ko sakht ta'ajjub hua. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki ummat ne is jamaat ki is ibadat par ta'ajjub kiya toh Allah Ta'ala ne is se bhi afzal cheez aap par nazil farmayi aur farmaya ke yeh afzal hai us se jin par aap aur aap ki ummat ne ta'ajjub zahir kiya tha. Pas An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke sahaba behad khush hue. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke is raat ka nek amal, is ka roza, is ki namaz ek hazar mahinon ke rozon aur namazon se afzal hai jin mein Lailatul Qadr na ho aur mufassireen ka bhi yeh qaul hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne bhi isi ko pasand farmaya hai ke woh ek hazar mahine jin mein Lailatul Qadr na ho, yahi theek hai. Is ke siwa aur koi qaul theek nahin, jaise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke ek raat ki jihad ki tayyari us ke siwa ki ek hazar raaton se afzal hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Isi tarah aur hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs achi niyat aur achi halat se Jumma ki namaz ke liye jaye us ke liye ek saal ke aamal ka sawab likha jata hai, saal bhar ke rozon ka aur saal bhar ki namazon ka, isi tarah ki aur bhi bahut si hadeesain hain. Pas matlab yeh hai ke murad ek hazar mahine se woh mahine hain jin mein Lailatul Qadr na aaye, jaise ek hazar raaton se murad woh raatein hain jin mein koi raat is ibadat ki na ho aur jaise Jumma ki taraf jane wale ko ek saal ki nekiyan yani woh saal jis mein Jumma na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke jab Ramzan aa gaya toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo! tum par Ramzan ka mahina aa gaya, yeh babarkat mahina aa gaya, is ke rozay Allah ne tum par farz kiye hain, is mein Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jate hain aur Jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jate hain, shayateen qaid kar liye jate hain, is mein ek raat hai jo ek hazar mahine se afzal hai, is ki bhalai se mehroom rehne wala haqeeqi badqismat hai. Nasai Shareef mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Chunke is raat ki ibadat ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se afzal hai is liye Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Jo shakhs Lailatul Qadr ka qayam imandari aur nek niyati se kare us ke tamam sabqa gunah bakhash diye jate hain. Phir farmata hai ke is raat ki barkat ki ziyadti ki wajah se bakasrat farishtay is mein nazil hote hain. Farishtay toh har barkat aur rahmat ke sath nazil hote rehte hain jaise tilawat-e-Quran ke waqt utarte hain aur zikr ki majlison ko gher lete hain aur ilm-e-deen ke seekhne walon ke liye raazi khushi apne par bicha diya karte hain aur is ki izzat-o-takreem karte hain. Rooh se murad yahan Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) hain, yeh khas ka atf hai aam par. Baaz kehte hain Rooh naam ke ek khas qisam ke farishtay hain jaise ke Surah Amma Yatasa'aloon ki tafseer mein tafseel se guzar chuka, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya woh sarasar salamti wali raat hai jis mein shaitan na toh burai kar sakta hai na eiza pahuncha sakta hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) wagairah farmate hain is mein tamam kamon ka faisla kiya jata hai, umr aur rizq muqaddar kiya jata hai jaise aur jagah hai: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem, yani isi raat mein har hikmat wale kaam ka faisla kiya jata hai. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) farmate hain ke is raat mein farishtay masjid walon par subh tak salam bhejte rehte hain. Imam Baihaqi (R.H) ne apni kitab Faza'il-e-Auqat mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka ek ghareeb asar farishton ke nazil hone mein aur namaziyon par un ke guzarne mein aur unhein barkat hasil hone mein warid kiya hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) se ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb bahut tool-taweel asar warid kiya hai jis mein farishton ka Sidratul Muntaha se Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath zameen par aana aur momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye duayein karna warid hai. Abu Dawood Tayalisi (R.H) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Lailatul Qadr sattaisween hai ya untisween, is raat mein farishtay zameen par sangrezon ki ginti se bhi zyada hote hain.

Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Ya'la farmate hain is raat mein har amr-e-ilahi se salamti hai yani koi nayi baat paida nahin hoti. Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid ka qaul hai ke yeh raat sarasar salamti wali hai, koi burai subah hone tak nahin hoti. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Lailatul-Qadr aakhri das raaton mein hai, jo in mein talab-e-sawab ki niyat se qayam kare Allah Ta'ala uske agle aur pichle gunah maaf farma deta hai. Yeh raat akai ki hai yani ikkiswein ya teisswein ya pachiswein ya sataiswein ya aakhri raat. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain yeh raat bilkul saaf aur aisi roshan hoti hai ke goya chand chadha hua hai, is mein sukoon aur diljam'i hoti hai, na sardi zyada hoti hai na garmi, subah tak sitare nahin jhadte. Ek nishani iski yeh bhi hai ke is subah ko suraj tez shuaon ke sath nahin nikalta balkeh woh chaudahwein raat ki tarah saaf nikalta hai. Is din uske sath shaitan bhi nahin nikalta. Yeh asnad to sahih hai lekin matan mein gharabat hai aur ba'az alfaaz mein nakarat bhi hai. Aur Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Lailatul-Qadr saaf pur-sukoon sardi garmi se khali raat hai, iski subah madham roshni wala surkh rang nikalta hai. Hazrat Abu Asim Nabeel apni asnad se Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne ek martaba farmaya main Lailatul-Qadr dikhlaya gaya phir bhula diya gaya, yeh aakhri das raaton mein hai, yeh saaf shaffaf sukoon-o-waqar wali raat hai, na zyada sardi hoti hai na zyada garmi, is qadar roshni raat hoti hai ke yeh maloom hota hai goya chand chadha hua hai, suraj ke sath shaitan nahin nikalta yahan tak ke dhoop chadh jaye.

Fasl: Is baab mein ulama ka ikhtilaf hai ke Lailatul-Qadr agli ummaton mein bhi thi ya sirf isi ummat ko khusoosiyat ke sath ata ki gayi hai. Pas ek hadith mein to yeh aaya hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne jab nazrein dalein aur yeh maloom kiya ke sabqa logon ki umrein bahut zyada hoti thin to aap (ﷺ) ko khayal guzra ke meri ummat ki umrein unke muqable mein kam hain to nekiyan bhi kam rahengi aur phir darajat aur sawab mein bhi kami rahengi to Allah Ta'ala ne aap (ﷺ) ko yeh raat inayat farmayi aur iska sawab ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se zyada dene ka wada farmaya. Is hadith se to yeh maloom hota hai ke sirf isi ummat ko yeh raat di gayi hai, balkeh sahib-e-Uddah ne jo Shafiya mein se ek imam hain, jamhoor-e-ulama ka yahi qaul naqal kiya hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur Khattabi ne to is par ijma naqal kiya hai lekin ek aur hadith hai jis se yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh raat jis tarah is ummat mein hai, agli ummaton mein bhi thi. Chunancha Hazrat Marsad farmate hain main ne Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se poocha ke aap ne Lailatul-Qadr ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kya sawal kiya tha? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya suno main Huzoor (ﷺ) se aksar baatein daryaft karta rehta tha, ek martaba main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to farmaiye ke Lailatul-Qadr Ramzan mein hi hai ya aur mahinon mein? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ramzan mein.

Main ne kaha achha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh ambiya ke sath hi hai ke jab tak woh hain yeh bhi hai jab ambiya qabz kiye jate hain to yeh uth jati hain ya yeh Qayamat tak baqi rahengi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke nahin woh Qayamat tak baqi rahegi, main ne kaha achha Ramzan ke kis hissa mein hai? Aap ne farmaya ise Ramzan ke pehle aur aakhri ashra mein dhoond. Phir main khamosh ho gaya, aap bhi aur baton mein mashghool ho gaye. Main ne phir mauqa pa kar sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in dono asharon mein se kis ashre mein is raat ko talash karoon? Aap ne farmaya aakhri ashre mein, bas kuch na poochna main phir chupka ho gaya lekin phir mauqa pa kar main ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki qasam hai mera bhi kuch haq aap par hai farma dijiye ke woh kaunsi raat hai? Aap sakht gusse hue main ne to kabhi aap ko apne oopar itna gussa hue hue dekha hi nahin aur farmaya aakhri hafta mein talash karo, ab kuch na poocha. Yeh riwayat Nasai mein bhi marwi hai is se sabit hota hai ke yeh raat agli ummaton mein bhi thi, aur is hadith se bhi yeh sabit hota hai ke yeh raat Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad bhi Qayamat tak har saal aati rahegi. Baaz Shia ka qaul hai ke yeh raat bilkul uth gayi, yeh qaul ghalat hai un ko ghalat fehmi is hadith se hui hai jis mein hai ke woh utha li gayi aur mumkin hai ke tumhare liye isi mein behtari ho yeh hadith poori bhi aayegi. Matlab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman se yeh hai ke is raat ki ta'ayyun aur is ka taqarrur bhi sath gaya na yeh ke sire se Lailatul Qadr hi uth gayi mandaraja bala hadith se yeh bhi maloom hua ke yeh raat Ramzan Sharif mein aati hai kisi aur mahina mein nahin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur ulama-e-Kufa ka qaul hai ke sare saal mein ek raat hai aur har mahina mein is ka ho jana mumkin hai. Yeh hadith is ke khilaf hai Sunan Abu Dawood mein baab hai ke us shakhs ki daleel jo kehta hai Lailatul Qadr sare Ramzan mein hai. Phir hadith laye ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Lailatul Qadr ke bare mein poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya ke sare Ramzan mein hai, is ki sanad ke kul rawi siqa hain yeh mauqoof bhi marwi hain Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) se ek riwayat mein hai ke Ramzan-ul-Mubarak ke sare mahina mein is raat ka hona mumkin hai Ghazali ne isi ko naqal kiya hai lekin Rafai ise bilkul ghareeb batlate hain.

Fasl: Abu Zareen R.H farmate hain ke Ramzan ki pehli raat hi Lailatul Qadr hai. Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H ka irfan hai ke yeh satraween shab hai. Abu Dawood mein is mazmoon ki ek hadith marfoo marwi hai aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A aur Hazrat Usman bin Al-Aas R.A se mauqoof bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri R.H ka mazhab bhi yahi naqal kiya gaya hai. Is ki ek daleel yeh bhi bayan ki jaati hai ke Ramzan-ul-Mubarak ki yahi satraween raat shab-e-jumma thi aur yahi raat Badr ki raat thi aur satraween tareekh ko jang-e-Badr waqay hui thi jis din ko Quran ne Yaum-ul-Furqan kaha hai. Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se marwi hai ke unneesween raat Lailatul Qadr hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ikeesween raat hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ramzan Shareef ke das pehle din ka aitikaf kiya, hum bhi aap ke saath hi aitikaf baithe. Phir aap ke paas Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye aur farmaya ke jise aap dhoondte hain woh toh aap ke aage hai. Phir aap ne das se bees tak ka aitikaf kiya aur hum ne bhi. Phir Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye aur yahi farmaya ke jise aap dhoondte hain woh toh abhi bhi aage hain yani Lailatul Qadr. Pas Ramzan ki beesween tareekh ki subah ko Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khade ho kar khutba farmaya aur farmaya ke mere saath aitikaf karne walon ko chahiye ke woh phir aitikaf mein baith jayen, main ne Lailatul Qadr dekh li lekin main bhool gaya. Lailatul Qadr aakhri ashre ki taaq raaton mein hai, main ne dekha hai ke goya main keechad mein sajda kar raha hoon. Rawi-e-hadith farmate hain ke Masjid-e-Nabwi ki chhat sirf khajoor ke patton ki thi, aasman par us waqt abr ka ek chhota sa tukda bhi na tha, phir abr utha aur barish hui aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khwab saccha hua aur main ne khud dekha ke namaz ke baad aap ki peshani par tar mitti lagi hui thi. Isi riwayat ke ek tareeq mein hai ke yeh ikeesween raat ka waqia hai. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim dono mein hai. Imam Shafi'i R.H farmate hain tamam riwayaton mein se zyada sahih yahi hadith hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Lailatul Qadr Ramzan Shareef ki taisseween raat hai aur is ki daleel Hazrat Abdullah bin Anees R.A ki Sahih Muslim wali aisi hi ek riwayat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh chaubeesween raat hai. Abu Dawood Tayalisi R.H mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Lailatul Qadr chaubeesween shab hai, is ki sanad bhi sahih hai. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein bhi yeh riwayat hai lekin is ki sanad mein Ibn-e-Lahi'ah hain jo za'eef hain. Bukhari mein Hazrat Bilal R.A se jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke moazzin hain, marwi hai ke yeh pehli saatween hai aakhri das mein se, yeh mauqoof riwayat hi sahih hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood, Ibn-e-Abbas, Jabir, Hasan, Qatadah, Abdullah bin Wahb bhi farmate hain ke chaubeesween raat Lailatul Qadr hai. Surah Baqarah ki tafsir mein Hazrat Wasilah bin Asqa ki riwayat ki hui marfoo hadith bayan ho chuki hai ke Quran-e-Karim Ramzan Sharif ki chaubeesween raat ko utra. Ba'az kehte hain pacheesween raat Lailatul Qadr hai, unki daleel Bukhari Sharif ki yeh hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ise Ramzan ke aakhri ashre mein dhoondo. Nau baqi rahein tab, saat baqi rahein tab, paanch baqi rahein tab. Aksar muhaddiseen ne iska yahi matlab bayan kiya hai ke is se murad taaq raatein hain, yahi zyada zahir hai aur zyada mashhoor hai, go ba'az auron ne ise juft raaton par bhi mahmool kiya hai jaise ke Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Saeed ne ise juft par mahmool kiya hai, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh sataisween raat hai, iski daleel Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai jis mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain yeh sataisween raat hai. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai, Hazrat Zirr ne Hazrat Ubayy ibn-e-Ka'ab (R.A) se kaha ke aap ke bhai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) toh farmate hain jo shakhs saal bhar raaton ko qayam karega woh Lailatul Qadr ko payega. Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala un par raham kare, woh jaante hain ke yeh raat Ramzan mein hi hai, yeh sataisween raat Ramzan ki hai. Phir is baat par Hazrat Ubayy ne qasam khai, maine poocha aap ko yeh kaise maloom hua? Jawab diya ke un nishaniyon ko dekhne se jo humein batayi gayi hain ke us din sooraj shua'on baghair nikalta hai.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ubayy R.A ne kaha us Allah ki qasam jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin ke yeh raat Ramzan mein hi hai, aap ne is par Insha'Allah bhi nahin farmaya aur pukhta qasam kha li. Phir farmaya mujhe khoob maloom hai ke woh kaunsi raat hai jis mein qayam karne ka Rasool Allah ﷺ ka hukum hai, yeh sataiswein (27th) raat hai. Is ki nishani yeh hai ke is ki subh ko suraj safed rang nikalta hai aur tezi zyada nahin hoti. Hazrat Muawiyah, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera se bhi marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya yeh raat sataiswein raat hai, salaf ki ek jamaat ne bhi yahi kaha hai aur Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H ka mukhtar maslak bhi yahi hai aur Imam Abu Hanifa R.H se ek riwayat isi qaul ki manqool hai. Baaz salaf ne Quran-e-Kareem ke alfaaz se bhi is ke suboot ka hawala diya hai is tarah ke "Hiya" is surat mein sataiswan (27th) kalma hai aur is ke ma'ani hain "yeh", Fallahu A'lam. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne as-hab-e-Rasool ﷺ ko jama kiya aur un se Lailatul Qadr ki babat sawal kiya to sab ka ijma is amr par hua ke yeh Ramzan ke aakhri ashra mein hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ne us waqt farmaya ke main to yeh bhi jaanta hoon ke woh kaunsi raat hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya phir kaho woh kaunsi raat hai? Farmaya is aakhri ashray mein saat (7) guzarne par ya saat baqi rehne par. Hazrat Umar R.A ne poocha yeh kaise maloom hua to jawab diya ke dekho Allah Ta'ala ne aasman bhi saat paida kiye aur zameen bhi saat banayin, mahina bhi hafton par hai, insaan ki paidaish bhi saat par hai, khana bhi saat hai, sajda bhi saat par hai, tawaf-e-Baitullah ki tadaad bhi saat ki hai, rami-e-jamar ki kankariyan bhi saat hain aur isi tarah ki saat ki ginti ki bohat si cheezein aur ginwa dein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne farmaya tumhari samajh wahan pahunchi jahan tak hamare khayalat ko rasai na ho saki. Yeh jo farmaya saat hi khana hai is se Quran-e-Kareem ki aayatein (Fa-anbatna feeha habba) (80. Abasa: 27) murad hain jin mein saat cheezon ka zikr hai jo khai jaati hain. Is ki asnaad bhi jayyid aur qawi hai ke untiswein (29th) raat hai. Hazrat Ubadah bin Samit R.A ke sawal ke jawab mein Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha ke ise aakhri ashray mein dhoondo taaq raaton mein, ikees (21), teees (23), pachees (25), satais (27) aur untis (29) ya aakhri raat. Musnad mein hai ke Lailatul Qadr sataiswein raat hai, ya untiswein. Is raat farishtay zameen par sangrezon ki ginti se bhi zyada hote hain, is ki asnaad bhi achi hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke aakhri raat Lailatul Qadr hai kyunke abhi jo hadith guzri is mein hai aur Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi hai ke jab nau (9) baqi reh jayen ya saat (7) ya paanch (5) ya teen (3) ya aakhri raat yani in raaton mein Lailatul Qadr ki talash karo, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, Musnad mein hai yeh aakhri raat hai.

Fasl: Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain ke in mukhtalif ahadith mein tatbiq yun ho sakti hai ke yeh sawalon ka jawab hai. Kisi ne kaha Hazrat hum ise falan raat mein talash karein? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya haan. Haqiqat yeh hai ke Lailatul Qadr muqarrar hai aur is mein tabdili nahin hoti. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka isi ma'ani ka qaul naqal kiya hai. Abu Qilabah (R.H) farmate hain ke aakhri ashre ki raaton mein yeh pher badal hua karti hai. Imam Malik (R.H), Imam Thawri (R.H), Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H), Imam Ishaq bin Rahuyah (R.H), Abu Thawr Muzni (R.H), Abu Bakr bin Khuzaymah (R.H) waghera ne bhi yahi farmaya hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) se bhi Qazi ne yahi naqal kiya hai aur yahi theek bhi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Is qaul ki thodi bahut ta'eed Bukhari-o-Muslim ki is hadith se bhi hoti hai ke chand ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khwab mein Lailatul Qadr Ramzan ki saat pichli raaton mein dikhaye gaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Main dekhta hoon ke tumhare khwab is bare mein muwafiq hain, har talab karne wale ko chahiye ke Lailatul Qadr ko in saat aakhri raaton mein talash kare. Hazrat Ayesha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se bhi Bukhari-o-Muslim mein marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Ramzan ke aakhri ashre ki taaq raaton mein Shab-e-Qadr ki justuju karo.

Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ke is farman par ke Lailatul Qadr har Ramzan mein ek mu'ayyan raat hai aur is ka her pher nahin hota, yeh hadith daleel ban sakti hai jo Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki riwayat se marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein Lailatul Qadr ki khabar dene ke liye (ke falan raat Lailatul Qadr hai) nikle. Do musalman aapas mein jhagad rahe thay to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke main tumhein Lailatul Qadr ki khabar dene ke liye aaya tha lekin falan falan ki ladai ki wajah se woh utha li gayi aur mumkin hai ke isi mein tumhari behtari ho, ab ise nawin, saatwin aur panchwin mein dhoondo.

Wajah-e-dalalat yeh hai ke agar is ka ta'ayyun hamesha ke liye na hota to har saal ki Lailatul Qadr ka ilm hasil na hota. Agar Lailatul Qadr ka taghayyur-o-tabaddul hota rehta to sirf us saal ke liye to maloom ho jata ke falan raat hai lekin aur barson ke liye ta'ayyun na hoti. Haan yeh ek jawab is ka ho sakta hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf usi saal ki is mubarak raat ki khabar dene ke liye tashreef laye thay. Is hadith se yeh bhi maloom hua ke ladai jhagda khair-o-barkat aur nafa dene wale ilm ko gharat kar deta hai. Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai ke banda apne gunah ke ba'is Allah ki rozi se mehroom rakh diya jata hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke is hadith mein jo Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke woh utha li gayi, is se murad is ke ta'ayyun ke ilm ka utha liya jana hai, na yeh ke bilkul Lailatul Qadr hi duniya se utha li gayi, jaise ke jahil Shia ka qaul hai. Is par badi daleel yeh hai ke is lafz ke baad hi yeh hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ise nawin, saatwin aur panchwin mein dhoondo.

Aap ka yeh farman ke mumkin hai isi mein tumhari behtari ho yani is ki muqarrara ta'ayyun ka ilm na hone mein, is ka matlab yeh hai ke jab yeh mubham hai to is ka dhoondne wala jin jin raaton mein is ka hona mumkin dekhe ga un tamam raaton mein koshish-o-khuloos ke sath ibadat mein laga rahe ga, bakhilaf is ke ke maloom ho jaye ke falan raat hi hai to woh sirf isi ek raat ki ibadat kare ga kyunke himmatein past hain, is liye hikmat-e-hakeem ka taqaza yahi hua ke is raat ke ta'ayyun ki khabar na di jaye taake is raat ke pa lene ke shauq mein is mubarak mahina mein jee laga kar aur dil khol kar bande apne Ma'bood-e-Barhaq ki bandagi karein aur aakhri ashre mein to poori koshish aur khuloos ke sath ibadaton mein mashghool rahein. Isi liye khud Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi apne inteqal tak Ramzan Sharif ke aakhri ashre ka aitikaf karte rahe aur aap ke baad aap ki azwaj-e-mutahharat ne aitikaf kiya, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki riwayat mein hai ke aap Ramzan Sharif ke aakhri ashre ka aitikaf kiya karte the. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ke jab aakhri das raatein Ramzan Sharif ki reh jatin to Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sari raat jaagte, apne ghar walon ko bhi jagate aur kamar kas lete (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in dinon mein jis mehnat ke sath ibadat karte utni mehnat se ibadat aap ki aur dinon mein nahin hoti thi. Yahi ma'ani hain oopar wali hadith ke is jumla ke ke aap tehband mazboot bandh liya karte yani kamar kas liya karte yani ibadat mein poori koshish karte, go is ke yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke aap biwiyon se na milte aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke dono hi baatein murad hon yani biwiyon se milna bhi tark kar dete the aur ibadat ki mashghooli mein bhi kamar bandh liya karte the. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith ke yeh alfaaz hain ke jab Ramzan ka aakhri ashra baqi reh jata to aap tehband mazboot bandh lete aur aurton se alag rehte. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain ke Ramzan ki aakhri das raaton mein Lailatul Qadr ki yaksan justuju kare, kisi ek raat ko dusri raat par tarjeeh na de (Sharh-e-Rafe'i). Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke yun to har waqt dua ki kasrat mustahab hai lekin Ramzan mein aur ziyadati kare aur khusoosan aakhri ashre mein aur bilkhusoos taaq raaton mein is dua ko ba-kasrat padhe: "Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni" (Aye Allah! Tu darguzar karne wala hai aur darguzar ko pasand farmane wala hai, mujh se bhi darguzar farma).

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke agar mujhe Lailatul Qadr mil jaye to main kya dua parhoon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yehi dua batayi. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh marwi hai aur Imam Hakim (R.H) ise shart-e-Bukhari-o-Muslim par sahih batate hain.

Ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar jis ka talluq Lailatul Qadr se hai, Imam Abu Muhammad bin Abu Hatim (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein is Surah ki tafsir mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) se is riwayat ke sath warid kiya hai ke Sidratul Muntaha jo saatwein aasman ki had par jannat se mutasil hai, jo duniya aur aakhirat ke fasle par hai, us ki bulandi jannat mein hai. Us ki shakhein aur daalein Kursi tale hain. Us mein is qadar farishtay hain jin ki ginti Allah Ta'ala ke siwa aur koi nahin jaanta. Us ki har ek shaakh par beshumar farishtay hain, ek baal barabar bhi jagah aisi nahin jo farishton se khaali ho. Us darakht ke beechon-beech Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ka maqam hai. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko aawaz di jaati hai ke, "Ae Jibraeel! Lailatul Qadr mein is darakht ke tamam farishton ko le kar zameen par jao." Yeh kul ke kul farishtay raafat-o-rahmat wale hain, jin ke dilon mein har har momin ke liye raham ke jazbaat maujzan hain.

Suraj ghuroob hote hi yeh kul ke kul farishtay Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath Lailatul Qadr mein utarte hain, tamam roo-e-zameen par phail jaate hain, har har jagah par sajde mein, qayam mein mashghool ho jaate hain aur tamam momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye duayein maangte rehte hain. Haan, girja ghar mein, mandir mein, aatish kaday mein, but khanay mein, gharz Allah ke siwa auron ki jahan parastish hoti hai wahan to yeh farishtay nahin jaate. Aur un jaghon mein bhi jin mein tum gandi cheezein daalte ho aur us ghar mein bhi jahan nashe wala shakhs ho ya nasha wali cheez ho ya jis ghar mein koi but gara hua ho ya jis ghar mein baajay gaajay ghantiyan hon ya mujasma ho ya koora karkat daalne ki jagah ho, wahan to yeh rahmat ke farishtay jaate nahin. Baqi chappe chappe par ghoom jaate hain aur saari raat momin mardon aurton ke liye duayein maangne mein guzaarte hain.

Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) tamam mominon se musafa karte hain. Us ki nishani yeh hai ke roo'ein jism par kharay ho jayen, dil narm par jaye, aankhein beh niklein. Us waqt aadmi ko samajh lena chahiye ke is waqt mera haath Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke haath mein hai. Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain, jo shakhs is raat mein teen martaba 'La ilaha illallah' parhay, us ki pehli martaba ke parhne par gunahon ki bakhshish ho jaati hai, dusri martaba ke kehne par aag se nijaat mil jaati hai, teesri martaba ke kehne par jannat mein dakhil ho jaata hai. Rawi ne poocha ke ae Abu Ishaq! Jo is kalma ko sachayi se kahe us ke? Farmaya: Yeh to nikle ga hi us ke munh se jo sachayi se is ka kehne wala ho. Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke Lailatul Qadr kafir-o-munafiq par to itni bhaari parti hai ke goya us ki peeth par pahar aa para.

Garaz fajr hone tak farishtay isi tarah rehte hain phir sab se pehle Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) charhte hain aur bohat oonchay charh kar apne paron ko phaila dete hain bilkhusoos un do sabz paron ko jinhein is raat ke siwa woh kabhi nahin phailatay, yahi wajah hai ke suraj ki tezi maand par jati hai aur shua'ein jati rehti hain, phir ek ek farishtay ko pukarte hain aur sab ke sab oopar charhte hain, pas farishton ka noor aur Jibraeel (A.S) ke paron ka noor mil kar suraj ko maand kar deta hai, is din suraj mutahayyar reh jata hai, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aur yeh saaray ke saaray beshumar farishtay is din aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye rahmat ki duayein mangte hain aur un ke gunahon ki bakhshish talab karne mein guzar dete hain, nek niyati ke sath rozay rakhne walon ke liye aur un logon ke liye bhi jin ka yeh khayal raha ke aglay saal bhi agar Allah ne zindagi rakhi to Ramzan ke rozay umdagi ke sath pooray karenge, yahi duayein mangte rehte hain, shaam ko dunya ke aasman par charh jate hain, wahan ke tamam farishtay halqay baandh baandh kar un ke paas jama ho jate hain aur ek ek mard aur ek ek aurat ke baray mein un se sawal karte hain aur yeh jawab dete hain, yahan tak ke woh poochte hain ke falan shakhs ko imsaal tum ne kis halat mein paya? To yeh kehte hain ke guzishta saal to hum ne usay ibadaton mein paya tha lekin is saal to woh bid'aton mein mubtala tha aur falan shakhs guzishta saal bid'aton mein mubtala tha lekin is saal hum ne usay sunnat ke mutabiq ibadaton mein paya, pas yeh farishtay us pehle shakhs ke liye bakhshish ki duayein mangni mauqoof kar dete hain aur is dusray shakhs ke liye shuru kar dete hain aur yeh farishtay unhein sunate hain ke falan falan ko hum ne zikr-e-Allah mein paya aur falan ko ruku mein aur falan ko sajday mein aur falan ko Kitabullah ki tilawat mein, garaz ek raat din yahan guzar kar dusray aasman par jate hain, yahan bhi yahi hota hai yahan tak ke Sidratul Muntaha mein apni apni jagah pahunch jate hain, us waqt Sidratul Muntaha un se poochta hai ke mujh mein basne walo! Mera bhi tum par haq hai, mein bhi un se mohabbat rakhta hoon jo Allah se mohabbat rakhein, zara mujhe bhi to logon ki halat ki khabar do aur un ke naam batao, Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) farmate hain ke ab farishtay us ke samne ginti kar ke aur ek ek mard-o-aurat ka ma'a walidiyat ke naam batate hain, phir Jannat Sidratul Muntaha ki taraf mutawajja ho kar poochti hai ke tujh mein rehne wale farishton ne jo khabrein tujhe di hain mujh se bhi to bayan kar, chunancha Sidra us se zikr karta hai, yeh sun kar woh kehti hai Allah ki rahmat ho falan mard aur falan aurat par, Allah unhein jaldi mujh se mila, Jibraeel (A.S) sab se pehle apni jagah pahunch jate hain, unhein ilham hota hai aur yeh arz karte hain: Parwardigar! Mein ne tere falan falan bandon ko sajday mein paya to unhein bakhsh, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mein ne unhein bakhsha, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) usay Arsh ke uthane wale farishton ko sunate hain, phir sab kehte hain falan falan mard-o-aurat par Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat hui aur maghfirat hui, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) khabar dete hain ke Bari Ta'ala! Falan shakhs ko guzishta saal to aamil-e-sunnat aur aabid chora tha lekin imsaal to bid'aton mein par gaya aur tere ahkaam se rogardani kar li hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Ae Jibraeel! Agar yeh marne se teen sa'at pehle bhi tauba kar le ga to mein usay bakhsh doonga, us waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) besakhta keh uthte hain: Allah! Tere hi liye sab tareefein sazawaar hain, Ilahi! Tu apni makhlooq par sab se zyada meharban hai, bandon par teri meharbani khud un ki meharbani se bhi barhi hui hai, us waqt Arsh aur us ke aas paas ki cheezein, parday aur tamam aasman junbish mein aa jate hain aur keh uthte hain: Alhamdulillahir-Raheem.

Alhamdulillahir-Rahim, Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) yeh bhi farmate hain ke jo shakhs Ramazan Sharif ke rozay pooray kare aur uski niyat yeh ho ke Ramazan ke baad bhi main gunahon se bachta rahoonga woh baghair sawal jawab ke aur baghair hisab-o-kitab ke Jannat mein dakhil hoga, Surah Lailatul Qadr ki tafsir Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Ghair mutaliqa riwayat aur behas: Maqsad yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Quran-e-Kareem ko Lailatul Qadr mein nazil farmaya hai, isi ka naam Lailatul Mubarakah bhi hai aur jagah irshad hai "Inna Anzalnahu fi Lailatin Mubarakatin" aur yeh bhi Quran se sabit hai ke yeh raat Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke mahine mein hai jaise farmaya "Shahru Ramazanallazi Unzila fihil Quran". Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera ka qaul hai ke poora Quran-e-Pak Lauh-e-Mahfooz se aasman-e-awwal par Bait-ul-Izzat mein is raat utra, phir tafseel-war waqiyat ke mutabiq batadreej teees (23) saal mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil hua. Phir Allah Ta'ala Lailatul Qadr ki shaan-o-shaukat ka izhar farmata hai ke is raat ki ek zabardast barkat toh yeh hai ke Quran-e-Kareem jaisi aala nemat isi raat utri, toh farmata hai ke tumhein kya khabar Lailatul Qadr kya hai? Phir khud hi batata hai ke yeh ek raat ek hazar mahina se afzal hai. Imam Abu Isa Tirmidhi (R.H) Tirmidhi Sharif mein is ayat ki tafseer mein ek riwayat laye hain ke Yusuf bin Sa'ad ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A) se jabke aap ne Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) se sulah karli kaha ke tum ne iman walon ke munh kaale kar diye ya yun kaha ke ae momino! ke munh siyah karne wale, toh aap ne farmaya Allah tujh par raham kare mujh par khafa na ho, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dikhlaya gaya ke goya aap ke mimbar par Banu Umayyah hain, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh bura maloom hua toh "Inna A'tainakal Kausar" nazil hui, yani jannat ki nahar-e-Kausar aap ko ata kiye jaane ki khush khabri mili aur "Inna Anzalnahu" utri, pas hazar mahine se woh murad hain jin mein aap ke baad Banu Umayyah ki mamlikat rahegi. Qasim kehte hain hum ne hisab lagaya toh woh pooray ek hazar din hue na ek din zyada na ek din kam. Imam Tirmidhi is riwayat ko ghareeb batlate hain aur is ki sanad mein Yusuf bin Sa'ad hain jo majhool hain aur sirf isi ek sanad se yeh marwi hai. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Imam Tirmidhi ka yeh farmana ke yeh Yusuf majhool hain is mein zara tazabzub hai, is ke bohat se shagird hain, Yahya bin Mueen kehte hain yeh mashhoor hain aur siqah hain, aur is ki sanad mein kuch iztirab hai, jaisa bhi hai Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-surat yeh bohat hi munkar riwayat hai, hamare sheikh Hafiz Hujjat Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko munkar batlate hain. (Yeh yaad rahe ke Qasim ka qaul jo Tirmidhi ke hawalay se bayan hua hai) ke woh kehte hain hum ne hisab lagaya toh Banu Umayyah ki saltanat theek ek hazar din tak rahi, yeh nuskhe ki ghalti hai, ek hazar mahine likhna chahiye tha, main ne Tirmidhi Sharif mein dekha toh wahan bhi ek hazar mahine hain aur aagay bhi yahi aata hai.

Mutarjim Qasim bin Fazl Haddani ka yeh qaul ke Banu Umayya ki saltanat ki theek muddat ek hazar mahine thi yeh bhi sahih nahin is liye ke Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki mustaqil saltanat san 40 Hijri mein qaim hui jabke Hazrat Imam Hasan (R.A) ne aap ke hath par bai'at kar li aur amr-e-khilafat aap ko sonp diya aur sab log bhi Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki bai'at par jama ho gaye aur is saal ka naam hi Aam-ul-Jama'ah mashhoor hua. Phir Sham waghera mein barabar Banu Umayya ki saltanat qaim rahi. Haan taqreeban nau saal tak Haramain Sharifain aur Ahwaz aur ba'az shehron par Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) ki saltanat ho gayi thi lekin taham is muddat mein bhi kulliyat-an un ke hath se hukumat nahin gayi albata ba'az shehron par se hukumat hat gayi thi. Haan san 132 Hijri mein Banu Abbas ne un se khilafat apne qabze mein kar li, pas un ki saltanat ki muddat banwaye baras hui aur yeh ek hazar mah se bahut zyada hai. Ek hazar mahine ke tirasi saal char mah hote hain. Haan Qasim bin Fazl ka yeh hisab is tarah to taqreeban theek ho jata hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki muddat-e-khilafat is ginti mein se nikal di jaye, Wallahu A'lam.

Is riwayat ke za'eef hone ki ek yeh wajah bhi hai ke Banu Umayya ki saltanat ke zamane ki to burai aur mazammat bayan karni maqsood hai aur Lailat-ul-Qadr ki is zamane par fazeelat ka sabit hona kuch un ke zamane ki mazammat ki daleel nahin. Lailat-ul-Qadr to har tarah bandagi wali hai hi aur yeh poori surat is mubarak raat ki madd-o-sataish bayan kar rahi hai, pas Banu Umayya ke zamane ke dinon ki mazammat se Lailat-ul-Qadr ki kaunsi fazeelat sabit ho jayegi? Yeh to bilkul wahi misal ho jayegi ke koi shakhs talwar ki tareef karte hue kahe ke lakri se bahut tez hai. Kisi behtareen fazeelat wale shakhs ko kisi kam darja ke zaleel shakhs par fazeelat dena to us shareef buzurg ki tauheen karna hai. Aur wajah suniye, is riwayat ki bina par yeh ek hazar mahine woh hue jin mein Banu Umayya ki saltanat rahegi aur yeh surat utri hai Makka Sharif mein to is mein un mahinon ka hawala kaise diya ja sakta hai jo Banu Umayya ke zamane ke hain? Is par na to koi lafz dalalat karta hai na ma'ani ke taur par yeh samjha ja sakta hai. Mimbar to Madina mein qaim hota hai aur hijrat ki ek muddat baad mimbar banaya jata hai aur rakha jata hai. Pas in tamam wajooh se maloom hota hai ke yeh riwayat za'eef aur munkar hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Mah-e-Ramzan aur Lailatul Qadr ki fazeelat: Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bani Israel ke ek shakhs ka zikr kiya jo ek hazar mah tak Allah ki rah mein yani jihad mein hathiyar band raha. Musalmanon ko yeh sun kar ta'ajjub maloom hua toh Allah Azzawajal ne yeh Surah utari ke ek Lailatul Qadr ki ibadat us shakhs ki ek hazar mahine ki ibadat se afzal hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Bani Israel mein ek shakhs tha jo raat ko qayam karta tha subh tak aur din mein dushmanan-e-deen se jihad karta tha sham tak, ek hazar mahine tak yahi karta raha. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Surah nazil farmaya ke is ummat ke kisi shakhs ka sirf Lailatul Qadr ka qayam us aabid ki ek hazar mahine ki is ibadat se afzal hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bani Israel ke char aabidon ka zikr kiya jinhon ne assi saal tak Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki thi, ek aankh jhapne ke barabar bhi Allah ki nafarmani nahin ki thi. Hazrat Ayyub (A.S), Hazrat Zakariya (A.S), Hazrat Hizqeel bin Ajooz (A.S), Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S). Ashab-e-Rasool (R.A) ko sakht ta'ajjub hua. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur kaha ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki ummat ne is jamaat ki is ibadat par ta'ajjub kiya toh Allah Ta'ala ne is se bhi afzal cheez aap par nazil farmayi aur farmaya ke yeh afzal hai us se jin par aap aur aap ki ummat ne ta'ajjub zahir kiya tha. Pas An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke sahaba behad khush hue. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke is raat ka nek amal, is ka roza, is ki namaz ek hazar mahinon ke rozon aur namazon se afzal hai jin mein Lailatul Qadr na ho aur mufassireen ka bhi yeh qaul hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne bhi isi ko pasand farmaya hai ke woh ek hazar mahine jin mein Lailatul Qadr na ho, yahi theek hai. Is ke siwa aur koi qaul theek nahin, jaise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke ek raat ki jihad ki tayyari us ke siwa ki ek hazar raaton se afzal hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Isi tarah aur hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs achi niyat aur achi halat se Jumma ki namaz ke liye jaye us ke liye ek saal ke aamal ka sawab likha jata hai, saal bhar ke rozon ka aur saal bhar ki namazon ka, isi tarah ki aur bhi bahut si hadeesain hain. Pas matlab yeh hai ke murad ek hazar mahine se woh mahine hain jin mein Lailatul Qadr na aaye, jaise ek hazar raaton se murad woh raatein hain jin mein koi raat is ibadat ki na ho aur jaise Jumma ki taraf jane wale ko ek saal ki nekiyan yani woh saal jis mein Jumma na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke jab Ramzan aa gaya toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo! tum par Ramzan ka mahina aa gaya, yeh babarkat mahina aa gaya, is ke rozay Allah ne tum par farz kiye hain, is mein Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jate hain aur Jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jate hain, shayateen qaid kar liye jate hain, is mein ek raat hai jo ek hazar mahine se afzal hai, is ki bhalai se mehroom rehne wala haqeeqi badqismat hai. Nasai Shareef mein bhi yeh riwayat hai.
